notes: Head of Product (Amina Patel) is driving the evaluation — primary ask: low-latency streaming + reliable tool-calling into HubSpot/Gmail/Calendar.
Initial preference: start on Redwood Hosted API for speed of integration; move to Dedicated reserved capacity if P95 latency and throughput validated.
Target latency: p95 end-to-end streaming < 250ms for short-turn responses, prefer <200ms if possible.  Critical for UX.
Tool calling: must support authenticated actions (create CRM lead, send email, schedule meeting). Token handling and audit logs required.
Scale expectations: pilot with 3 live SDR agents concurrently, production target 40-60 concurrent outbound agents across NA region.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, wants concrete cost model for hosted vs dedicated and a path to optimize unit economics (batching, quantization).
Security ask: SAML SSO for admin console, KMS integration for tool credentials, audit logging retained for 1 year.
Quote from Amina on 2026-02-25 call: "If streaming can't hit ~200ms p95, the agents will feel laggy and adoption drops."
Competitive checks: they benchmarked OpenAI Chat + custom connector; pain points were unpredictable latency under bursts and tool-call retries.
AE note: interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and model/quant recommendations tied to outbound agent workload.

poc_scope: Validate hosted API streaming + tool-calling for outbound SDR agents.
